metadata.description: The suite's own unit tests: the configuration guard, the helpers, and the check that every /oauth/* and /.well-known/* operation of the published OpenAPI document has a wire test. Needs no server. The OpenAPI document is an input because the coverage check reads it.

Run the black-box wire suite against a running QAuth (ADR-018 §5). Talks to the server only over HTTP. Needs QAUTH_BASE_URL, the seeded client id and secret, and QAUTH_WIRE_ALLOW_WRITES=1, because it creates users. Never cached: its input is a live server, not files. See apps/wire-suite/README.md.
